newsitem.title: CANADA: Fire causes minor damage at Alcan plant.
newsitem.headline: Fire causes minor damage at Alcan plant.

text.p: A chimney fire at an Alcan Aluminium Ltd continuous casting plant on Thursday caused minor damage, the company said.
Production at the reroll sheet located at the company's Saguenay works in Jonquiere, Quebec was expected to resume in 48 hours, spokesman Richard Godin told Reuters.
About 80 workers were evacuated at midday today when the fire broke out in a chimney. The fire appeared to have started when a worker was using a blowtorch on a nearby ventilation system, Godin said.

There were no injuries in the fire, which was quickly brought under control. Damage was estimated at C$100,000. The facility makes reroll aluminum sheet, which is then shipped to other Alcan facilities for further processing.
